## Research or software need

What problem would this change solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful interface and how it would be tested.

## Scope check

Confirm that the proposal makes no clinical, diagnostic, treatment, dosing,
monitoring, alerting, or state-of-the-art claim.

## Alternatives and limitations

What simpler approaches were considered, and what would remain unresolved?
